subject: 아틀란티스 근위상어
prompt: Create ONE isolated collectible concept thumbnail for the cozy Korean ocean game Pongdang Island. Redesign the existing epic 'Atlantean Guard Shark' for the Star-sleep Ruins theme using BLUE and YELLOW as the defining palette. A handsome friendly ancient royal guard SHARK, streamlined recognizable shark anatomy, broad rounded snout, small expressive intelligent eye, gill slits, powerful crescent tail, two natural pectoral fins. Deep cobalt and lapis blue back, soft sky blue underside, rich warm butter-yellow and antique gold segmented ceremonial armor across brow, shoulders and dorsal fin. Restrained carved spiral-wave medallion enclosing a trident motif, tiny weathered ceramic facets, ancient submerged kingdom craftsmanship. Design is elegant and readable, about 65% blue / 30% yellow / 5% pale highlights. A few large intentional armor shapes instead of clutter; no human limbs, no weapons held, no crown, no extra creatures. STYLE reference supplied: use its soft colored outlines, sophisticated hand-painted dimensional gradients and delicate luminous materials ONLY. Do not copy its manta anatomy, giant eye proportions, wings, ribbon tail, star pattern or purple palette. New art direction: polished storybook fantasy game illustration, tactile matte blue ceramic and softly brushed warm gold, inviting rounded shapes, crisp silhouette, restrained ornament. Avoid photorealistic metal, harsh black outlines, plastic 3D render and excessive sparkle. Face SCREEN RIGHT in a clear side or side-three-quarter profile. The head, mouth and snout point to the right; the body and tail trail behind to the left. Show forward swimming toward the right, never backward swimming. Complete full body at 76-80% canvas width, generous transparent padding all sides, readable at 132px. Square PNG with real alpha transparency. No background, checkerboard, scene, ground, shadow outside subject, detached particles, bubbles, external glow, text, UI, border or watermark.
